```python
import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b'\n')
    if not data:
        return
    k = int(data[0].strip())
    text = data[1].strip() if len(data) > 1 else b''
    
    # Build tokens: each token is a piece that must stay together on a line.
    # A word with hyphens is split into pieces: "sa-le" -> "sa-", "le"
    # Spaces are attached to the preceding piece.
    tokens = []
    n = len(text)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        # read a word
        j = i
        while j < n and text[j] != 32:  # not space
            j += 1
        word = text[i:j]
        # split word by hyphens, keeping hyphen at end of each part except last
        start = 0
        for p in range(len(word)):
            if word[p] == 45:  # '-'
                tokens.append(word[start:p+1])
                start = p + 1
        tokens.append(word[start:])
        # attach space to last piece if there is a space after word
        if j < n and text[j] == 32:
            tokens[-1] = tokens[-1] + b' '
            j += 1
        i = j
    
    # Remove trailing space from last token
    if tokens and tokens[-1].endswith(b' '):
        tokens[-1] = tokens[-1][:-1]
    
    # Binary search minimal width
    # Check if can fit in k lines with given width
    def can_fit(width):
        lines = 1
        cur = 0
        for tok in tokens:
            L = len(tok)
            if L > width:
                return False
            if cur == 0:
                cur = L
            elif cur + L <= width:
                cur += L
            else:
                lines += 1
                if lines > k:
                    return False
                cur = L
        return lines <= k
    
    lo = 1
    hi = n  # max possible width
    # Find minimal width
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if can_fit(mid):
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid + 1
    print(lo)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
```
